name: cadre-lifecycle-gitlab
description: GitLab-flavored Agentic SDLC gate governance: lifecycle-review-gitlab records gate decisions from a real GitLab MR approval (approve-from-gitlab/approve-from-gitlab-mr); gitlab-gate-tracking publishes GitLab tracking issues for a task's gates and assigns linked approval-subtask issues to each gate's authority (create-gate-issues/list-gate-issues); link-source-issue-gitlab records a real GitLab issue as the recorded source for a task's G1 (Intent) or G2 (Requirements Baseline) gate (link-intent-from-gitlab-issue/link-requirements-from-gitlab-issue); publish-gate-status-gitlab posts (and idempotently updates) a one-way, read-only gate-status summary note on a task's GitLab MR (publish-gate-status/list-gate-status); report-gate-reviewers-gitlab reports (read-only, never sets) which GitLab usernames would be set as MR reviewers for a task's lifecycle gates (request-gate-reviewers-gitlab). Requires cadre-lifecycle-core to also be installed and a recent-enough agentic-sdlc kernel.

interface.shortDescription: Record Agentic SDLC gate decisions and publish gate/approval tracking issues in GitLab.
interface.longDescription: Conversationally record a lifecycle gate decision sourced from an actual GitLab merge request approval (approve-from-gitlab/approve-from-gitlab-mr), publish GitLab tracking issues for a task's gates with linked approval subtasks assigned to each gate's authority (create-gate-issues/list-gate-issues), record a real GitLab issue as the recorded source for a task's G1 (Intent) or G2 (Requirements Baseline) gate (link-intent-from-gitlab-issue/link-requirements-from-gitlab-issue), post (and idempotently update) a one-way, read-only gate-status summary note on a task's GitLab MR (publish-gate-status/list-gate-status), or report (read-only, never sets) which GitLab usernames would be set as MR reviewers for a task's lifecycle gates (request-gate-reviewers-gitlab). Requires cadre-lifecycle-core.
defaultPrompt: Use lifecycle-review-gitlab to record a gate decision from a GitLab MR approval.
Use gitlab-gate-tracking to publish GitLab issues for this task's gates and approvals.
Use link-source-issue-gitlab to record a GitLab issue as the source for a task's G1 or G2 gate.
Use publish-gate-status-gitlab to post or refresh a one-way, read-only gate-status summary note on this task's GitLab MR.
Use report-gate-reviewers-gitlab to see which GitLab usernames would be set as MR reviewers for a task's lifecycle gates (read-only, never sets).
